verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching KYC/KYB is a single marketing line ('Onboard quickly, leveraging existing KYC data'), which suggests Adyen consumes externally-sourced KYC data rather than running its own documented KYC/KYB verification flow. There is no documentation of KYB for businesses, data requirements, review states, or re-verification/refresh processes for cardholders. Missing for 10: documented KYC data requirements, KYB flow for business cardholders, review/approval states, re-verification triggers and cadence, and any API/webhook evidence for verification status changes.
